propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend Protocol because it is missing query_project and assert_env_ready methods that Cloud's JiraBackend implements
The reconciler.backend config validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' even though the backend is registered and resolvable via select_backend(), creating an unreachable-registered gap

Inbound DC user identity minting fails silently because the accountId guard in _ensure_inbound_assignee_identity returns early on DC's name/key user model, preventing the invalid creation_channel ValueError from surfacing
A writing reconcile pass against Jira Data Center crashes with AttributeError on set_entity_property, which the core calls from three sites but the TicketTransport Protocol never declares
The test_backend_contract.py fixture parametrizes only over ['fake', 'jira'] and has never validated the DC backend against any generic port assertion
